units.claim: The domain layer is src/domain, the innermost entities layer.
The application layer in src/application holds use cases, ports, errors and validation.

citations.quote: ├── application - Application or Use cases layer

units.claim: The presentation (interface adapters) layer in src/presentation holds controllers, responses and middlewares.
The infrastructure layer in src/infrastructure holds the express and knex frameworks and the repository implementations.
The main layer in src/main is the composition root with factories, and may depend on all other layers.

citations.quote: It may depend on all other layers in the system.

units.claim: Layers run from the inside out as domain, application, presentation, infrastructure, main, and data flows between them in that order.

citations.quote: In our case, data enter the system via "express routes" (infrastructure layer) to the "controllers" (adapters layer), to the "use cases" (application layer), to the "domain" (domain/entities layer).
